proposals.applied_note: Triaged 2026-05-07 Day 97 evening Clawd-Day extension. Decision: defer per-tool retirement to post-Phase-1-coil-winding (Saturday+). Documenting the gap as self-knowledge: 50/64 unused includes large dormant-by-design cluster (memory_*, *_consult, plan_*, trigger_*, market_data, wolfram, wsl) where usage cadence is event-driven not weekly. True retirement candidates need docstring-by-docstring audit to distinguish dormant-by-design from genuinely-superseded. Not blocking; no autocatalytic decay risk on the proposals themselves now that dedup is fixed.
